cohort_definition: Undergraduate Summer Analysts in Lazard's Financial Advisory business (New York generalist and specialist groups plus Chicago, Charlotte, Minneapolis, San Francisco, Houston and other US offices), penultimate-year students, and the full-time Analyst class they convert into. Asset Management and MBA Summer Associates are out of scope.

compensation_notes.note: Official 2027 Financial Advisory Summer Analyst postings state: 'We expect the base salary for this role to be approximately $120,000 USD' — an annualized base figure on the posting under pay-transparency practice; the posting does not state how summer pay is prorated, and this record does not convert it.

data_sources.label: Lazard official ATS posting: 2027 Financial Advisory Summer Analyst Program — Chicago Healthcare (eligibility, 9-week program, week-long New York training, ~$120,000 base salary expectation)
Lazard official ATS posting: 2026 Financial Advisory Summer Analyst Program — Shareholder Advisory & Activism Defense (publishes a minimum 3.7 GPA)
Lazard official ATS event posting: New York Leadership & Insight Day — 2027 Summer Analyst (min 3.7 GPA; Jan 12 application deadline; assessment + questionnaire + video interview as next steps)
Lazard official ATS event posting: Sophomore Networking Night (2027 Summer Analyst recruiting) — min 3.5 GPA for the sophomore event
Lazard official ATS posting: Lazard Veterans Analyst Program (mentorship pipeline into the summer analyst interview process; application deadline Dec 12)

entry_routes.details: Nine-week program; hired directly into a group (in New York: M&A/Restructuring generalist, Capital Structure Advisory, Corporate Strategy, Shareholder Advisory, Private Capital Advisory; sector groups in other offices). Starts with a week-long training program in New York, with formal mentorship through the summer.
entry_routes.route: Financial Advisory Summer Analyst Program — the main route

entry_routes.details: Selective one-day program (Feb 4, 2026 edition) for students graduating Winter 2027–Spring 2028: senior-leader access, banker networking, and workshops; application required essays on leadership/inclusion/team motivation and a minimum 3.7 GPA. A visibility feeder into the summer analyst process.
entry_routes.route: New York Leadership & Insight Day (early-insight feeder)

entry_routes.details: School-based sophomore networking events (documented at Duke for the 2027 cycle; min 3.5 GPA to be eligible for that event) and the Veterans Analyst Program, which pairs student veterans with mentors ahead of the summer analyst interview process (application deadline Dec 12 for the edition on record).

Program materials describe the internship's goal as offering successful candidates a full-time opportunity on graduation (program overview syndicated from Lazard's program description). No conversion rate is published and none is stated.

hiring_bar_summary: Firm-published bar, with an important split: the general 2027 Financial Advisory postings require 'top academic performance' with no number, while specific Lazard postings DO publish numbers — a minimum 3.7 GPA on the 2026 Shareholder Advisory & Activism Defense summer posting and on the Leadership & Insight Day application, and a minimum 3.5 GPA for a sophomore networking event (all official ATS postings, verified 2026-10-12). Eligibility for the 2027 cohort: US university enrollment, bachelor's expected Dec 2027 or May/June 2028, strong quantitative background, analytical skills, communication, attention to detail, and multi-tasking. Plan against 3.7 as the firm's revealed comfort level where a number exists, while noting the generalist posting itself does not print one.

dated_windows.window: Leadership & Insight Day (2027 cycle feeder): applications by Monday, January 12, 2026; event February 4, 2026
Sophomore Networking Night (2027 recruiting): apply by Wednesday, November 5 (2025, for the 2027 cycle)
Veterans Analyst Program: application deadline Friday, December 12, 11:55 PM ET (edition on record)

hiring_cadence.summary: Annual junior-summer cycle with winter feeder events: Insight Day applications closed January 12, 2026 for the Summer 2027 pipeline, and sophomore networking ran the preceding November. The main summer postings for 2027 were live on the firm's ATS as of verification (2026-10-12 crawl), but the postings reviewed do not print a single firm-wide application deadline — deadlines appear to be posting-specific, so each group's live posting governs. Re-verify per posting each cycle.

interview_styles.style: Assessment-led early stage (documented for the Insight Day pipeline): an aptitude assessment, a personality questionnaire, and a short video interview follow application review

Technical/fit mix (reported IB norm, not firm-published): accounting and valuation fluency plus judgment/maturity questions — consistent with the postings' emphasis on quantitative background, poise, and creativity, but the topic list itself is community-reported

known_biases_of_data: GPA evidence is uneven by design of the firm's own postings: numbers appear on specialist/event postings (3.7, 3.5) while generalist postings say 'top academic performance.' This record preserves that split instead of generalizing one number across the firm.
Built from official ATS postings verified via search-index crawls of the official URLs (the ATS serves a bot check to direct automated reads).
No licensed population sample: school, major, and prior-employer distributions are omitted by design rather than estimated.
Feeder-event facts (Insight Day, sophomore nights) are single-edition records; formats and GPA floors for those events can change yearly.

major_dist.note: All majors are encouraged on the firm's early-insight postings; the generalist summer postings emphasize quantitative background over a specific major. No major mix of actual hires is published.

path_patterns.pattern: Direct-to-group summer hiring: New York summers are hired into a specific group (M&A/Restructuring, Capital Structure Advisory, Corporate Strategy, Shareholder Advisory, Private Capital Advisory) rather than a generalist pool, per the firm's program description.
A visible pre-junior pipeline exists: sophomore networking nights and a selective Insight Day feed the junior-summer process a year ahead, both with published GPA floors.

Mentorship is structural, not incidental: summer analysts get formal mentorship and leadership exposure; the Veterans Analyst Program extends 1-on-1 mentorship ahead of interviews for student veterans.

prior_employer_dist.note: Not published by the firm; omitted rather than estimated.

process_stages.stage: Online application to a specific group/office posting on the firm's ATS

For the Insight Day pipeline: aptitude assessment + personality questionnaire + short video interview after application review (documented sequence for that program; the main summer process stages beyond application are not enumerated on the postings reviewed)
Nine-week summer program beginning with a week-long comprehensive training program in New York, then group placement work

red_flags: GPA confusion is the trap: 3.7 appears on specific Lazard postings (Shareholder Advisory 2026; Insight Day), 3.5 on a sophomore event, and no number on the generalist postings. Quoting any single figure as 'the Lazard GPA requirement' without naming the posting is wrong.
No firm-wide application deadline is printed on the 2027 postings reviewed; third-party pages quoting one should be checked against the live group posting.
The ~$120,000 figure is an annualized base expectation on the posting, not the summer stipend amount.
Small-firm framing cuts both ways: with just over 3,000 employees firm-wide (per the postings), class sizes are small — but the firm publishes no class size, so do not quote one.
referral_weight_notes: The firm publishes no referral policy for campus hiring. Its documented early pipeline runs through firm-run events (Insight Day, sophomore networking, veterans mentorship) rather than open referrals. Reported norm (labeled): as at other boutiques, banker relationships built at those events and through school channels are widely reported to matter for interview selection; that is community reporting, not firm policy.
sample_size_note: No licensed population dataset was used. Curated-qualitative CIR from the firm's official postings; no population percentages are stated.

school_dist.note: No school distribution is published by the firm for this cohort and no licensed population sample was available, so no distribution is stated. The firm does run school-specific sophomore events (one documented at Duke), which is an event fact, not a hiring distribution.

screening_signals.signal: Minimum 3.7 GPA printed on the Shareholder Advisory & Activism Defense summer posting (2026 cycle) — proof the firm uses numeric GPA screens on at least some postings
Generalist 2027 postings screen on 'top academic performance' plus strong quantitative background — no number printed
Graduation-window eligibility is a hard screen (Dec 2027 or May/June 2028 for the Summer 2027 cohort; US university enrollment required)
Early-pipeline screens are also numeric: 3.7 minimum for Insight Day, 3.5 minimum for the documented sophomore networking event

skills_dist.note: Skills are the postings' stated work content: financial analysis and modeling, company/industry research, client-presentation development, and (in Shareholder Advisory) equity-capital-markets and shareholder-data analysis, including use of developing AI tools. Stated requirements, not measured frequencies among hires.

thesis_text: Bottom line: Lazard hires Financial Advisory summer analysts directly into groups for a nine-week program that opens with a week of training in New York, and its published GPA signals are the strictest in this batch where numbers exist — a 3.7 minimum on its Shareholder Advisory summer posting and on its Leadership & Insight Day application, against 'top academic performance' with no number on the generalist postings (official ATS postings, verified 2026-10-12). Who gets in, per the firm's stated screen: US undergraduates graduating December 2027 or May/June 2028 for the 2027 cohort, with a strong quantitative background and the maturity/poise the postings repeatedly name. What the firm says vs. what to plan for: treat 3.7 as the firm's revealed comfort level even where a posting omits a number, and treat the early pipeline as part of the real process — sophomore networking (3.5 floor on the documented event) and the winter Insight Day feed the junior summer a year ahead. Routes in, ranked: (1) the group-specific summer application (New York generalist/specialist groups or a sector office); (2) the Insight Day / sophomore event pipeline for visibility before the application year; (3) the experience ladder underneath — prior finance internships that make the quantitative screen credible. Compensation signal: 2027 postings state an expected base salary of approximately $120,000 (annualized figure on the posting). Key dates: feeder deadlines are printed per event (Insight Day applications closed January 12, 2026 for the 2027 pipeline); the main postings reviewed print no firm-wide deadline, so check the live group posting. Risks and alternatives: the small, group-specific classes leave little room for a generic application; Evercore and the bulge brackets run different mechanics and are the natural hedges. Offer to execute: pick target groups, verify each live posting's deadline, and build the technicals plan against the assessment stage.

values_culture_signals.signal: Postings frame Lazard as a close, collaborative community of just over 3,000 professionals with an entrepreneurial culture and flat structure, where 'our people make the difference' and mentorship is formalized
